decisions.reason: Correctly identifies the two workspace-files inserts and locates the fatal duplicate at EntryGroup.update during Cordis include composition.
Correctly distinguishes safe config override, safe new insertion, and fatal insertion of an already bundle-provided ID, with evidence-based classification.
Prescribes removing only the profile’s redundant workspace-files insert, retaining the bundle declaration and using configuration override if needed.
Correctly states the failure occurs before plugin execution and cannot be fixed in plugin code, but does not explicitly separate the earlier resource-read failure as still requiring verification.
Recommends inspecting the installed bundle patch and proposes an actionable diagnostic naming both sources and directing removal of the profile block.
